title: Objection evidence INSERT is not atomic with the guarded terminal UPDATE — a crash between the two statements leaves an objected row with no reference_objection_log row
evidence:
Ok(pog.Returned(_, [_, ..])) -> {
          // The transition happened — write the Art 21 evidence (once).
          insert_objection_evidence(
            config.db,
            config.sentry,
            id_uuid,
            app_uuid,
            row.ref_slot,
            channel,
            payload_ref,
          )
detail: sql.terminalize_reference_call (UPDATE) and insert_reference_objection_log (INSERT) are two separate pog.execute calls with no transaction. A crash/connection drop in the window yields status='objected' with no Art 21 evidence row — the AC4 'written at objection time' guarantee silently breaks. INSERT failure alone is captured, the between-statements window is not.
recommended_fix: Wrap the guarded UPDATE and the evidence INSERT in one DB transaction (pog transaction), or run the evidence INSERT inside the same statement batch as the terminalize UPDATE.

title: decline_reason is bounded only client-side (maxlength=200); a crafted POST stores unbounded free text in the row's result JSONB
detail: The only length bound on the decline reason is the HTML maxlength attribute. apply_decline accepts any trimmed non-empty string verbatim and persists it into the result JSONB via minimal_terminal_result, where RC4 will render it to the landlord. A crafted POST bypasses the 200-char cap with arbitrary-length text.
recommended_fix: Add a server-side bound in apply_decline (e.g. truncate or reject reasons over 200 chars) before building minimal_terminal_result.
